title: Dashboard Shell — one responsive shell + mobile dock
description: One responsive dashboard shell with a single nav SSOT. React/Next stays the default shadcn rail + topbar + mobile dock/tile-drawer distribution. Explicit Svelte/SvelteKit gets native rail/topbar/dock/tile-drawer UI over the same framework-neutral nav matching, dock derivation, and active-title core; Svelte uses CSS breakpoints and $app/state instead of React/shadcn/vaul.

scenarios.title: Desktop
scenarios.description: Collapsible rail + topbar. Toggle the trigger to see icon-collapse.

scenarios.title: Secondary column
scenarios.description: Rail + narrow contextual column + content — the three-column archetype.

scenarios.title: Mobile dock
scenarios.description: The bottom dock the same nav produces on small screens.

scenarios.title: Mobile menu drawer
scenarios.description: The tile drawer the dock's Menu button opens — the mobile face of the rail.
